cohort: The study included women who delivered after one anastomosis gastric bypass (OAGB) between 2017 and 2024, alongside a control group matched for preoperative body mass index, age, delivery history, and delivery year.
finding: One anastomosis gastric bypass was associated with reduced rates of gestational diabetes mellitus, gestational hypertensive disorders, excessive fetal growth, and induction of labor, but also with lower hemoglobin levels requiring more intravenous iron supplementation and an increased rate of small-for-gestational-age infants.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was similar between the OAGB and control groups.
